evidence: No dangerous code construct (dynamic evaluation, non-literal command execution) sits in the execute path from the repo's entry points at the scanned commit
expected_output: Gated SAST rows: check_id, path, line, severity (ERROR|WARNING|INFO), message, reachable (true|false|unknown), not_affected, call_path (the call path as the artifact when reachable)

assertions.description: Zero ERROR-severity SAST hits reachable — or of unknown reachability — from the repo's entry points.

notes: M4's flagship move generalized from advisories to code findings: semgrep runs rampscan's vendored ruleset (pinned, offline — never the registry), and the sast-reachability collector gates every hit through graph.db. A hit is not_affected only when the over-approximate walk (every edge kind) cannot reach the file from any entry point or declared route. No graph, no entry points, or a file the graph never saw → the hit counts, marked unknown. WARNING-severity hits ride along as observations but do not violate.
